about_the_game:
Experience the World After the Battle of Red Cliffs

Inspired by traditional Chinese Lianhuanhua (comic books) and 90s Chinese textbooks, The Righteousness: SanGuo brings hand-drawn characters to life, carefully crafted to capture the essence of Chinese artistry. Step into a 2.5D Metroidvania world styled like a classic Chinese Lianhuanhua!

Game Features

A Gripping Storyline

As a mysterious assassin, you set out to eliminate Cao Cao on the battlefield of Red Cliffs—but why did you lose your memory? Travel across the land, uncover forgotten truths, and meet legendary heroes as you unveil a catastrophe that threatens the world. Will you and your allies be able to save the people from disaster?

A Vast and Beautiful World

Explore over ten unique locations, from peaceful villages to brutal warzones, from endless deserts to snow-covered forests. The Righteousness: SanGuo showcases breathtaking landscapes inspired by China's diverse scenery!

Discover Hidden Treasures

Through exploration and combat, collect rare treasures to grow stronger, unlocking previously inaccessible areas. Delve into the unknown, acquire powerful artifacts, and defeat formidable new enemies!

A Diverse Cast of Enemies

Encounter over 80 meticulously hand-drawn enemies, including formidable warriors, legendary beasts, and ruthless assassins. Each boss fight is uniquely designed, featuring beautifully animated enemy deaths—proving that this world is full of surprises!

Battle in the Air and on Horseback

Your journey is not limited to walking—storm enemy camps on horseback or take to the skies for intense aerial combat! These unique gameplay segments are woven into the story, ensuring an ever-fresh experience.

Demo Information

Demo Information

The Demo of The Righteousness: SanGuo allows players to experience the comic book-style visuals and get a taste of this side-scrolling ARPG before its full release.

  • No Save Function – This special prologue version does not support saving. However, players can replay the three available stages as many times as they like.

  • Language – To enhance historical immersion, the test version defaults to Traditional Clerical Script commonly used during the Three Kingdoms period.

  • Content Differences – The demo may differ from the final release.

As an independent developer, I am committed to continuously refining the game. This is just the beginning, not the end!

If you enjoy the game, please add The Righteousness: SanGuo to your wishlist—your support means the world to me!

Thank You for Your Support!

short_description: A 2.5D Metroidvania set in the Three Kingdoms era, built with UE4. In The Righteousness: SanGuo, experience beautiful hand-drawn visuals inspired by Chinese Lianhuanhua (comic books). Seek the meaning of life amidst the chaos of war and unravel the mystery that could save the world!
